_about: Public-domain Alexander Topp, minister of Knox's Church, Toronto, for the Word Hoard: The River of Life in Ezekiel's Vision, his Sabbath-school lessons, New Year Addresses to the Young, and his last sermon. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 122 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

topp-new-year-addresses: New Year addresses to the young (Toronto : J. Bain, 1880)
topp-perpetuity: The perpetuity of the reign of Christ : the last sermon preached by late Rev. Alexander Topp, D.D ([Toronto? : s.n.], 1879)
